genericMidiScope.sectionEnd: maximum corrected end unit of retained source-derived content in the incomplete final measure

partition.scope: per source track/channel and per derived measure
partition.reuseRule: assign an onset-group to an already available action whose prior event ends no later than the new onset
reusePreference: minimum absolute anchor-pitch distance from the action's previous sounding event
partition.newAction: create a new derived action only when no existing action is available

ordering.actionAnchor: first sounding event's highest MIDI pitch within the measure
tieBreak: highest pitch encountered in the measure descending
ordering.rationale: Use one deterministic generic-MIDI branch without claiming recovered treble/bass identity; it also aligns with the existing generic MIDI chord profile's highest-written/downward orientation.

accidentalState.policy: Restart generated accidental state from the active key signature after each in-accord/measure-division boundary. Do not claim knowledge of whether a print accidental was present in the unavailable source score.
accidentalState.futureExplicitPrintAdapter: A future adapter carrying explicit print accidental presence may additionally apply BANA dot-5 transcriber-added accidental restatement semantics.

serialization.singleSection: action1 + part-measure-in-accord + action2 [+ ...]; no measure-division sign when only one section exists
serialization.futureMultipleSections: section + measure-division + section, with no spaces around the measure-division sign
serialization.measureSeparatorAfterIncompleteFinalMeas: normal enclosing transport/score behavior; no invented extra section

syntheticImplementationGates: incomplete 4/4 final measure with two actions emits one part-measure in-accord
each side totals exactly the incomplete section duration
first note after part-measure sign has forced octave
complete measure still uses full-measure in-accord
single-section H4D emits no measure-division sign

realWorldAcceptance.oxygene4.mid: must progress beyond the current incomplete-final-measure part-measure blocker
